blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A rare label seldom occurs alone, and a classifier can recover it from the frequent labels it co-occurs with, its companions, without having learned the label itself. Existing diagnostics of this need a trained model: none says before training whether a corpus admits the failure, or what the standard aggregate hides. Macro-F1, like any measure built from per-label confusion counts, is unchanged by how a label's recall divides between occurrences with and without a companion. We introduce a within-label estimand of that division, a reading rule under which a fall in dependence counts only if companion-free recall rises, and a statistic of training labels that bounds, before training, how far reported recall can exceed companion-free recall. Across 23 corpora, 7 training objectives and five families of label-correlation mechanisms, companion-free recall falls short on all six corpora where the estimand is defined. Up to 18.4% of the tail true positives macro-F1 credits would vanish at the companion-free rate, within the training-label bound on every corpus. No long-tail objective reduces the dependence, but architecture moves it. Models whose tail score is computed from other labels' predictions are strongly dependent.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Long-tailed multi-label classification is usually framed as a difficulty of learning: most labels are rare, rare labels are hard ( Zhang and Zhou, 2014 ; Tarekegn et al., 2021 ) , and the field’s methods address that difficulty with reweighted losses ( Lin et al., 2018 ; Cui et al., 2019 ; Wu et al., 2021 ; Ben-Baruch et al., 2021 ) , margin adjustments ( Cao et al., 2019 ; Menon et al., 2021 ) and architectures that exploit label correlation ( Chen et al., 2019 ; Xun et al., 2020 ; Yang et al., 2018 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) . Progress is measured by macro-F1 over the tail ( Xiao et al., 2021 ; Xiao et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) , which weights every label equally and so refuses to let frequent labels dominate the score.
blocks.zh: 长尾多标签分类通常被设定为学习难度:大多数标签为稀有,稀有标签为难(张和周,2014;Tarekegn等,2021),而球场的方法用再加权损失解决了这一难度(林等,2018;邱等,2019;吴等,2021;本-巴鲁克等,2021),比值调整. (Cao等,2019;Menon等,2021)和利用标签关联的建筑(Chen等,2019;Xun等,2020;Yang等,2018;Yan等,2025). 进展由尾部上方的宏-F1来测量(小等等,2021;小等,2022;许等,2023),每条标签均重,因此拒绝让频繁的标签主导得分.

blocks.en: Rare labels are not merely rare, however. They are rare and they seldom occur alone. In large annotation vocabularies a tail label often appears in documents that also carry a few frequent labels ( Charte et al., 2014 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) , and those frequent labels are easy. A classifier can therefore recover the rare label reliably without having learned anything about it, by recognizing its frequent companions and predicting the rare label alongside them ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) . Where the rare label appears without its companions the same classifier may fail entirely ( Singh et al., 2020 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,罕见的标签并不仅仅是罕见的。 它们很少见,很少单独出现。 在大型注解词汇中,尾部标签经常出现在同样带有少数频繁标签的文件中(Charte等,2014;Xu等,2023),而这些频繁标签也很容易被使用. 因此,分类者可以通过识别其频繁的伴行并预测与之并存的稀有标签(Geirhos等,2020年;Fan等,2023年)来可靠地恢复稀有标签. 如果罕见的标签出现时没有伴生,同样的分类器可能完全失效(Singh等,2020;Xie等,2024.).

blocks.en:
What is missing is a measurement. The phenomenon itself is known: models amplify the co-occurrence statistics of their training corpora ( Zhao et al., 2017 ) , co-occurring classes are exploited as a shortcut in vision ( Singh et al., 2020 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) and text ( Fan et al., 2023 ) , and many methods use label correlation deliberately as a feature ( Chen et al., 2019 ; Xun et al., 2020 ) . Each of these works either removes the dependence or exploits it, and the diagnostics they use are computed from a trained model’s errors. None can say before training whether a corpus admits the failure, which is when a benchmark is chosen and compute is committed, and none relates the dependence to what an evaluation measure reports. Statistics of label co-occurrence in datasets exist ( Herrera et al., 2016 ; Charte et al., 2014 ) , but none is tied to what an evaluation measure can hide, and the literature on the blind spots of evaluation measures ( Sokolova and
Lapalme, 2009 ; Wu and Zhou, 2017 ) has not addressed this one. This paper supplies the instrument: a measure of the dependence, a characterization of what the aggregate cannot see, and a bound available before training.

所缺少的是衡量。 现象本身是已知的:模型放大了他们训练的同化子(赵等,2017年),同化子(同化子)课程被利用为视觉的捷径(辛格等,2020年;谢等,2024年)和文字(范等,2023年),许多方法故意将标签关联作为特征(陈等,2019年;Xun等,2020年). 每一部作品要么消除依赖性,要么利用依赖性,它们所用的诊断方法都是从训练有素的模型的错误中计算出来的。 在培训之前,任何人都不能说一个实体是否承认失败,即选择基准和计算时发生的失败,也没有人将依赖性与评价衡量报告的内容联系起来。 关于数据集中标签共发性的统计数据存在(Herrera等人,2016年;Chalte等人,2014年),但没有一项数据与评价措施可以隐藏什么有关,有关评价措施盲点的文献(Sokolova和S.
Lapalme, 2009; Wu and Zhou, 2017)没有针对这个. 本文提供了工具:衡量依赖性、描述总量所看不到的东西,以及培训前可用的约束。

blocks.en: Two models with identical macro-F1 can differ completely in whether they recover a rare label alongside its companions or without them. Per-label F1, and therefore any mean of per-label F1 scores, depends only on how many of a label’s occurrences are recovered, not on which, so it is unchanged by how recall divides between the occurrences that carry a companion (supported) and those that carry none (independent). The same holds for every measure built from per-label confusion counts.
blocks.zh: 两种具有等同的宏-F1的模型,在它们是否与它的伴星一起回收出一个稀有的标签或者没有它们上可以完全不同. Per-label F1, 以及因此每个标签 F1 的分数的平均值, 仅取决于一个标签的出错被回收多少次, 而不是哪一次, 对每个标签上的错位计数构建的每个衡量标准都是一样的。

blocks.en: We therefore measure the division directly. The within-label effect d d is the mean, over tail labels, of recall on supported occurrences minus recall on independent ones. It is read under a co-report rule: a fall in d d counts as a correction only if independent recall rises, since a model can lower d d by predicting less on the supported occurrences. A screening statistic, the mean support ratio π ¯ \bar{\pi} , is computed from training labels alone and bounds the inflation of reported recall, R − R I R-R_{I} , the amount by which a label’s recall exceeds its recall on independent occurrences. We then audit 23 corpora in 10 clusters with 7 training objectives and five families of correlation-exploiting mechanisms. The mechanisms divide into those that only adjust a tail label’s document-based score with label correlation and those whose tail score is derived from other labels’ predictions. The stakes are concrete: on Ohsumed, 18.4% of the tail true positives that macro-F1 credits would vanish if companion-supported occurrences were recalled at the companion-free rate, and between 3.0% and 7.6% on the other large-vocabulary corpora.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下。

blocks.en: 1. A training-free screening statistic, the mean support ratio π ¯ \bar{\pi} , computed from training labels alone, that bounds before any model is trained how far reported tail recall can exceed companion-free recall. Existing diagnostics of companion dependence need a trained model. Our diagnostic tells, when a benchmark is chosen, whether a corpus admits the failure at all. 2. A within-label estimand with a co-report rule, which reads a fall in dependence as a correction only if companion-free recall rises. Unlike the intuitive difference of F1 scores, it is not driven by base rates and cannot be lowered by damaging the model. 3. An exact decomposition of per-label recall into companion-supported and independent components, under which every measure built from per-label confusion counts is invariant to how recall divides between them. This invariance motivates the estimand. We characterize how wide the blind spot is in practice. 4. An audit of 23 corpora, of which the estimand is defined on six (four independent clusters), across training objectives and mechanism families. Its findings locate the dependence: the training objective does not move it, but whether a tail score is derived from other labels’ predictions does. 5. A model-agnostic evaluator that reads prediction files, used unchanged on a retrieval-augmented language model.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Label dependence in multi-label learning has been analyzed theoretically by Dembczyński et al. (2012) , who distinguish conditional from marginal dependence and use the distinction to choose learning objectives. Singh et al. (2020) separate “exclusive” from “co-occurring” test distributions in object recognition, report accuracy on each, and propose de-correlating training objectives. Both works concern models and objectives rather than measurement.
blocks.zh: 多标签学习中的标签依赖性在理论上被Dembczyński等分析(2012年),他们区分了有条件的和边际的依赖性,并利用区分来选择学习目标. Singh等(2020年)在物体识别方面将“排他性”与“共同发生的”试验分布分开,报告每个试验的准确性,并提出脱钩培训目标。 这两项工作都涉及模型和目标,而不是衡量。

blocks.en: The closest line of work to our screening statistic is SCUMBLE and REMEDIAL ( Charte et al., 2014 ; Charte et al., 2015 ; Charte et al., 2019 ) . SCUMBLE measures the concurrence of minority with majority labels without training, and its per-label variant SCUMBLE Lbl ( Charte et al., 2019 ) is computed from the label matrix alone. Its purpose is to estimate how hard a dataset is to resample, and REMEDIAL decouples training instances on the strength of the statistic ( Charte et al., 2015 ) . The line of work neither audits datasets with an evaluation measure nor has a notion of entailment: a companion that accompanies a label by definition counts the same as one whose association is behavioral. Over the 23 corpora of our study, SCUMBLE Lbl correlates with our screening ratio π ¯ \bar{\pi} at r = + 0.590 r=+0.590 (dataset-level SCUMBLE: + 0.694 +0.694 ). The two measure neighboring quantities by different constructions: SCUMBLE is an inequality index over per-label imbalance ratios, π ¯ \bar{\pi} a proportion of a label’s positives.

blocks.en: 2.1 The phenomenon as a shortcut
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 作为捷径的现象

blocks.en: A model that succeeds by a feature that does not generalize is learning a shortcut ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ) . Companion dependence is an instance. The companion helps predict the tail label during training and is absent when the tail label later appears alone. Zhao et al. (2017) compute a corpus-level bias score from training co-occurrence counts and show that models amplify it at test time, a fairness harm motivating corpus-level correction. Our statistic instead bounds what an evaluation measure can conceal. Gardner et al. (2021) argue that for a class of language tasks every feature correlation is spurious and derive a statistical test for artifacts from data alone. Our screening statistic is similar in spirit, restricted to co-occurrence between labels and tied to a specific claim about what an aggregate score can hide.
blocks.zh: 一个由不通俗化的特性所成功的模型是学习捷径(Geirhos等,2020年). 对同伴的依赖就是一个例子。 同伴在训练期间帮助预测尾部标签,而当尾部标签日后单独出现时则缺席. 赵等. (2017年)从训练共犯中计算出实体级偏差分数,并显示模型在测试时放大了该分数,这是鼓励实体级修正的公平损害. 相反,我们的统计数字限制了评价措施可以隐瞒什么。 Gardner等人(2021年)认为,对于一类语言任务来说,每个特征关联都是虚假的,仅从数据就得出了对文物的统计测试. 我们的筛选统计在精神上是相似的,仅限于标签之间的共同出现,并且与关于总分可以隐藏什么的具体说法挂钩。

blocks.en: Xie et al. (2024) treat co-occurring features as carrying both a helpful and a harmful causal effect and diagnose the harm with a conditional false-positive rate computed from a trained model’s errors. Fan et al. (2023) name the mechanism in text the label correlation shortcut and propose a counterfactual classifier to remove it, and Rawlekar et al. (2024) enforce class co-occurrence probabilities through a graph network. None of these supplies a statistic available before training. Xu et al. (2023) identify companion dependence in long-tailed multi-label text classification and observe that augmenting data for one label also affects its co-occurring labels, Xiao et al. (2022) augment tail instances pairwise, Lanchantin et al. (2020) mask labels so a model learns from partial label sets, and Duarte et al. (2021) mask labels to correct class imbalance rather than correlation. Xiao et al. (2021) meta-learn a mapping from head-label to tail-label classifiers, and Wang et al. blocks.en: 2.2 Group robustness and dataset characterization
blocks.zh: 2.2 组群稳健性和数据集特征

blocks.en: The paper is closely related to worst-group evaluation under spurious correlation, where an average conceals a group on which the model fails. Oakden-Rayner et al. (2019) name this hidden stratification, and Sagawa et al. (2020) compute worst-group accuracy with groups given by annotated attributes. Methods for unannotated subgroups infer them by clustering a trained model’s features ( Sohoni et al., 2020 ; Eyuboglu et al., 2022 ) . In multi-label data the groups are induced by label co-occurrence and computable from the label matrix alone, which is what makes a screening statistic possible.
blocks.zh: 该文件在虚假的关联下与最坏的组别评价密切相关,因为平均值掩盖了模型失败的组别. Oakden-Rayner等 (2019) 将这个隐藏分层命名,而相川等 (2020) 用注释属性给出的组计算出最差组的准确性. 未加说明的分组的方法通过集成一个训练有素的模型的特征来推断(Sohoni等人,2020年;Eyuboglu等人,2022年)。 在多标签数据中,这些组别是通过标签共同发生而诱导的,并且仅从标签矩阵即可计算,因此可以进行筛选统计。

blocks.en: A recent survey focused on single-label data ( Ye et al., 2025 ) notes that available metrics require a trained model. Surveys of multi-label data characterize datasets thoroughly but stop short of a metric. Herrera et al. (2016) catalog cardinality, density, mean imbalance ratio, SCUMBLE and the theoretical complexity score (TCS), and Tarekegn et al. (2021) survey the imbalanced multi-label methods built on them. Zhang and Zhou (2014) organize methods by how much label correlation they model, an axis Huang et al. (2024) restate for current work, and Szymański et al. (2016) build label co-occurrence graphs from training data to partition the label space for method design. These characterizations carry no evaluation measure.

blocks.en: 2.3 Properties of evaluation measures
blocks.zh: 2.3 评价措施的属性

blocks.en:
Asking what an evaluation measure cannot see is a well-studied question. Sokolova and
Lapalme (2009) give the canonical taxonomy of which changes to a confusion matrix leave which classification measures unchanged. For multi-label measures, Wu and Zhou (2017) unify eleven metrics through label-wise and instance-wise margins, Sebastiani (2015) derives a measure from axioms and shows that F1 violates several of them, Waegeman et al. (2015) show that optimizing Hamming or subset 0/1 loss as a surrogate for the F-measure incurs high worst-case regret, Opitz (2024) observes that macro-averaged measures are routinely chosen without their properties being stated, and Pereira et al. (2018) find most multi-label measures highly correlated with one another. The invariance studied here is of a different kind from those in the taxonomy of Sokolova and
Lapalme (2009) , which concern changes a confusion matrix can express. Section 3.2 returns to the comparison.
blocks.zh:
问评估措施看不到什么是一个经过充分研究的问题。 索科洛娃和
Lapalme(2009年)给出了犬科分类法,该分类法改变为分类计量不变的混淆矩阵。 就多标签措施而言,吴和周(2017年)通过标签和实例比值统一了11个度量衡,Sebastani(2015年)从轴向中得出了一个度量,并表明F1违反了其中若干度量衡,Waegeman等人(2015年)表明,优化Hamming或子集0/1损失作为F-度量的替代物,令人深感遗憾,Opitz(2024年)指出,宏观平均计量是例行选择,而不说明其属性,Pereira等人(2018年)发现大多数多标签措施彼此密切相关。 这里研究的变异性与索科洛娃的分类学和

blocks.en:
Information retrieval faces a structurally similar problem when the evaluation signal is partial. Buckley and
Voorhees (2004) design bpref for incomplete relevance judgments, computing it only over judged documents, an idea our estimand takes up. Sakai (2007) shows that standard measures applied to condensed lists are more robust to incompleteness than bpref itself. Ferrante et al. (2020) determine which arithmetic a measure permits, Amigó et al. (2009) derive formal constraints an evaluation metric should satisfy, and Fuhr (2018) catalogs recurring errors in retrieval evaluation, several of which stem from inadequate measures.

blocks.en: 2.4 Propensity-scored evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.4 适当评分评价

blocks.en: Propensity-scored precision ( Jain et al., 2016 ) corrects for labels missing from the ground truth. Our measure is orthogonal, in that it addresses predictions that are present in the ground truth but correct for the wrong reason, in the sense of McCoy et al. (2019) for natural language inference, where a model scores well through a heuristic that holds for frequent cases and breaks on the rest. Propensity-scored precision conflates missing labels with the long tail ( Schultheis et al., 2022 ) . Its scores can exceed their own maximum and its fitted parameters do not transfer between collections. This led to budgeted utilities that target long-tail performance directly ( Schultheis et al., 2024b ) and to consistent algorithms for the macro-at- k k family ( Schultheis et al., 2024a ) . Whether a correct prediction was made for the right reason is a third axis beside missingness and tail weighting, and the replacement metrics are themselves built from per-label confusion counts, so correcting the tail weighting does not recover the split within a label. Wei and Li (2020) make the complementary observation that tail labels affect Top- k k precision and nDCG@ k k so little that they can be trimmed from the label space with little loss on either, and Ullah et al. (2024) find that standard extreme-classification evaluation, which captures only the order of scores, says nothing about calibration.

blocks.en: 3 Formalism
blocks.zh: 3 形式主义

blocks.en: This section fixes notation, characterizes what count-based measures cannot see, and derives our estimand. Two constructions for it suggest themselves, and both are confounded, one by a base-rate artifact severe enough to invert its sign and one by Simpson’s paradox. The estimand instead measures the effect within each label and averages, and it is read under a rule that a reduction in dependence counts only when independent recall rises.

blocks.en: 4.2 Models and objectives
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式和目标

blocks.en: Every loss-side run is a label-wise attention classifier ( Mullenbach et al., 2018 ) on a pretrained transformer encoder chosen per corpus for its domain, i.e., Legal-BERT ( Chalkidis et al., 2020b ) on the two EUROVOC corpora, BiomedBERT ( Gu et al., 2022 ) on the two MeSH corpora, and BERT-base ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) on Wiki10-31K, AmazonCat-13K, AAPD and arXiv-157, for which no in-domain encoder is an obvious fit. We train with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) at a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} for the encoder and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for every other parameter, batch size 16, linear warm-up over the first 10% of steps, weight decay 0.01, gradient clipping at 1.0, and early stopping on validation loss at a patience of two epochs. Table A.1 gives, per corpus, the encoder, input length, training budget and number of objectives, and the tail micro-F1 of the binary cross-entropy baseline, which lies between 0.058 0.058 and 0.168 0.168 on the five corpora whose label spaces run into the thousands and between 0.428 0.428 and 0.525 0.525 on the three with at most 130 labels.

blocks.en: 4.3 Mechanism arms
blocks.zh: 4.3 机制武器

blocks.en: Correlation-exploiting methods are evaluated as ladders: a family’s arms, each compared with a control from the same architecture with the mechanism disabled, holding capacity and training fixed where the family allows it. We re-implement four families from the literature and one of our own under the common protocol. Table 3 specifies every arm. No arm reads gold labels at inference. Gold labels enter only as co-occurrence statistics estimated on the training split, and, for one arm, as teacher-forced inputs during training.
blocks.zh: 相关开发方法被评价为梯子:一个家庭的武器,与同一结构的控制相比,其机制已经失效,在家庭允许的情况下保留能力和培训。 我们重新执行4个家庭的文献 和我们自己的一个 根据共同协议。 表3列明了每个臂. 没有手臂读取黄金标签的推断。 黄金标签只作为培训分开时估计的共同发生率统计数据输入,对一个臂来说,作为教师在培训期间提供的投入。

blocks.en: We sort the arms by where the tail label’s score comes from. An adjusting arm keeps a tail score computed from the document and modifies it with label correlation. We count the graph family in the manner of Chen et al. (2019) (with GATv2 rather than GAT ( Veličković et al., 2018 ) , since GAT’s attention is static ( Brody et al., 2022 ) ), the correlation network of Xun et al. (2020) , and an inference-time co-occurrence reranker in the manner of Yan et al. (2025) as adjusting mechanisms. A deriving arm computes the tail score from other labels’ predictions. Here, we count the sequence decoder of Yang et al. (2018) , which conditions each step on the labels it has already emitted, its label-only variant, whose tail scores see no document and only the label sequence the decoder generates, and the substitute arm of a family we construct so that its two arms differ only in whether a tail label’s score is replaced by evidence from the top predicted labels (substitute) or adjusted by it (gate). The label-only and substitute arms are constructed positive controls in the spirit of partial-input baselines ( Gururangan et al., 2018 ; Poliak et al., 2018 ) . Nothing is withheld from the input, but where the tail score may be computed from is constrained. The sequence-decoding family pools the encoder output rather than using label-wise attention, so its control is the plain BCE baseline and its rows carry a capacity difference the other families do not.
blocks.zh: 我们用尾标签的分数排序手臂。 调整臂保留从文档中计算出一个尾分并用标签关联来修改. 由于GAT的注意力是静态的(Brody等,2022年),Xun等的关联网络(2020年),以及以Yan等(2025年)为调整机制的推论-时间重排,因此我们按Chen等(2019年)的方式计算出图表家族. 从其他标签的预测中推算出尾分。 在此,我们计算杨等人(2018年)的序列解码器,该序列在它已经发布的标签上规定了每个步骤的条件,只有标签的变体,它的尾分没有看到文档,只有解码器生成的标签序列,我们构建的一个家族的替代臂,因此它的两臂只在尾分被顶级预言标签(替代)或由它调整(门)的证据所取代. 只有标签和替代武器是本着部分投入基线的精神构建的积极控制(Gurururangan等,2018年;Poliak等,2018年)。 输入时没有任何保留,但从尾分中计算出来的则受到限制。 序列解码家族会将编码器输出集合起来,而不是使用标签式的注意,所以它的控制是平地的BCE基线,而它的行带有其他家族没有的能力差异.

blocks.en:
To show that the evaluator needs only prediction files, we also audit one retrieval-augmented language model on Ohsumed. Documents and label names are embedded with the 33M-parameter all-MiniLM sentence encoder ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Reimers and
Gurevych, 2019 ) , served as all-minilm:33m , the 40 labels whose names are most similar to a document are retrieved, and Gemma 4 E2B ( Team et al., 2026 ) selects among them by name at temperature zero, with the prompt given in Appendix F . The arm produces label sets without logits and is evaluated by the same code as every other arm. Retrieval reads documents and label names and never label co-occurrence, so it cannot learn companion structure from the labels. However, this does not mean that it is companion-neutral, because a document that carries a tail label’s companions may be more topical for that label’s name, which is what Section 5.6 measures.

blocks.en: We first establish that the estimand measures companion dependence and that the effect is present (RQ1), then ask whether objectives move it (RQ2), how much of it training labels reveal (RQ3), and which design property moves it (RQ4). If a long-tail objective addressed companion dependence, it should lower the relative effect while raising independent recall, a correction by Definition 4 , and do so on more than one corpus.
We pair each of six objectives with BCE by seed on the three corpora that carry a full grid and an estimable effect, 18 cells in total, flag each at | σ | > 2 |\sigma|>2 , apply a Holm correction across all 18, and give each cell the hierarchical bootstrap of Section 4.4 (Table A.2 ).
Table 5 contains no correction. 5 of the 18 cells are flagged. Four are rises: focal loss on Ohsumed by +0.037 at 4.7 standard errors, while independent recall falls at 6.0, class-balanced and distribution-balanced losses on EURLEX57K, and logit adjustment on Ohsumed, whose independent-recall term does not clear the bar. The fifth is damage: distribution-balanced loss lowers the effect on Wiki10-31K by -0.156 at 4.0 standard errors, the largest reduction in the grid, while independent recall does not move (0.8 standard errors) and supported recall falls (5.7). Without the co-report this cell would read as a correction. After Holm correction 1 of the 5 flagged cells is significant at 0.05 0.05 , distribution-balanced loss on EURLEX57K. The bootstrap, which also resamples labels, is stricter still where labels are few. 2 of 18 intervals exclude zero, 2 of the 5 flagged cells, focal loss and logit adjustment on Ohsumed, both rises, while the EURLEX57K cells rest on 35 labels and their intervals include zero. No objective is flagged on more than one corpus, and distribution-balanced loss is flagged in opposite directions on two.
No objective is shown to reduce companion dependence, two are shown to raise it on Ohsumed, and none behaves the same way on a second corpus. An objective’s effect on companion dependence is a property of the objective and the corpus together.

Statistics S2–S4 should predict where the estimand, or a mechanism arm, cannot be read.
We compare the verdict of each, computed from training labels, with what the audit found.
S4 excludes the Chilean abusive-clause corpus, because of its 24 labels, a split at the median leaves 12 tail labels, of which 3 are estimable in both contexts and 9 have no supported positive at all, although the corpus has over a thousand training documents. S2 separates two corpora from one family, that is, arXiv-157 carries 2.4 2.4 times AAPD’s label space but screens five times lower ( 0.017 0.017 against 0.091 0.091 ), because it averages 1.37 1.37 labels per document against 2.41 2.41 . This heuristic has exceptions. RCV1-V2 regions ( 1.28 1.28 labels per document) and the Chilean dark-pattern corpus ( 1.13 1.13 ) screen at 0.289 0.289 and 0.407 0.407 . S3 flags Wiki10-31K, which has the richest companion sets in the register ( | C | = 14.11 |C|=14.11 ) but 30,938 labels against 14,146 training documents, a median of two positives per tail label from which to learn a companion mapping. Section 5.5 shows that its label-only arm collapses due to this. Since objectives do not move the effect consistently, we test whether it matters if a tail label’s score is derived from other labels’ predictions or merely adjusted by them.
Each arm of Table 3 is compared with its own control on the relative effect.
Figure 3 draws every arm against its control. Fourteen of the fifteen adjusting arms stay within + 0.07 +0.07 of their controls. A few on Ohsumed and PubMed MeSH are flagged only because their seeds are tight, and then by at most + 0.05 +0.05 , and the reranker on EURLEX57K falls slightly below its controls. A pooled control can hide how far its parts disagree. The correlation network’s two controls on EURLEX57K read 0.654 and 0.561, a spread of 0.092 against the arm’s shift of + 0.011 +0.011{} , so that contrast is bounded by its controls rather than read as the mechanism. One adjusting arm does move. The dynamic graph arm on EURLEX57K rises by + 0.30 +0.30 at 3.0 3.0 standard errors. However, it does not replicate on Ohsumed ( + 0.03 +0.03 ) or PubMed MeSH ( + 0.06 +0.06 , not flagged), although PubMed MeSH’s tail receives as large a share of companion evidence through the same fixed graph, and we have no explanation for it. The deriving arms move the effect most. Where flagged, outside Wiki10-31K, they sit clear of zero by + 0.17 +0.17 to + 0.76 +0.76 . On Ohsumed, for instance, SGM moves by + 0.20 +0.20 and the label-only arm by + 0.35 +0.35 , each at more than six standard errors. SGM and its teacher-forced variant on PubMed MeSH ( + 0.03 +0.03 and + 0.07 +0.07 ), and the teacher-forced variant on EURLEX57K, whose + 0.33 +0.33 reaches only 1.6 1.6 standard errors across widely spread seeds, are not flagged. The deriving arms at or below zero are on Wiki10-31K, examined below.
What moves the effect most is how the tail score is built. An arm reads as strongly dependent when its tail score is derived from other labels’ predictions, with one unexplained adjusting exception on one corpus.

blocks.en:
If the distinction between adjusting and deriving reflects a mechanism, it should replicate across vocabularies and fail only where S3 says the mechanism cannot be learned.
We run the derivation family on three further corpora, namely PubMed MeSH, which shares Ohsumed’s MeSH-derived vocabulary, AmazonCat-13K, an independent retail taxonomy, and Wiki10-31K, which fails S3. Every arm is read with the co-report of Definition 4 .
On PubMed MeSH, substitute reads 0.736 0.736 against gate at 0.319 0.319 ( 2.6 2.6 standard errors), in the same direction as Ohsumed but noisier. On AmazonCat-13K it reads 0.474 0.474 against 0.297 0.297 , a difference of + 0.177 +0.177 at 2.9 2.9 standard errors. This is the smallest effect we observe, although the substitute arm there retains more of its control’s supported recall (15% against 4 to 5% on the MeSH corpora), so capability does not explain the ordering. On Wiki10-31K the deriving arms fall below their controls (substitute 0.547 0.547 against 0.941 0.941 , the label-only arm 0.312 0.312 against 0.960 0.960 ), but independent recall falls on both, by 0.045 0.045 and 0.052 0.052 at more than ten standard errors, so by Definition 4 both reductions are damage, drawn as open markers in Figure 3 .
The distinction holds on four corpora in three independent clusters (legal, biomedical and retail vocabularies) and breaks only on the corpus where S3 predicts that a label-only mapping cannot be learned, where the co-report identifies the break as damage rather than counter-evidence.

The evaluator is defined on prediction sets, not on models, so it should apply unchanged to a system that is not a trained classifier and attribute a dependence to the stages of a pipeline.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Theoretical implications
blocks.zh: 6.1 理论影响

blocks.en: Count-based tail measures have a blind spot of quantifiable width. Lemma 1 shows that whenever π ⁡ ( l ) ≤ R ⁡ ( l ) ≤ 1 − π ⁡ ( l ) \pi(l)\leq R(l)\leq 1-\pi(l) the counts leave the split between supported and independent recall entirely undetermined, so the question of whether a tail label was learned is not one a macro- or micro-averaged score can answer. The answer has to be measured within labels. The two between-label constructions that suggest themselves are confounded, one by a base-rate artifact that reverses its sign on one of our corpora and one by Simpson’s paradox. The audit then locates the variation. Companion dependence is present wherever it can be estimated, no loss-side objective reduces it, and what moves it is whether the tail score is derived from other labels’ predictions. This places the phenomenon in the corpus and the architecture.

Lemma 1 显示,每当 QQ (l) QR (l) QQ (l) 1 – π (l)\ pi (l)\ leq R (l)\ leq 1-\ pi (l) 计数时, 被支持与独立召回之间的分数完全未定, 所以是否得知了尾端标签的问题不是一个宏观或微观平均分数的问题可以回答. 答案必须在标签内测量。 两种标签之间的构思都令人困惑,一种是基础率的文物,它颠倒了我们公司的一个标志,另一种是辛普森的自相矛盾。 然后,审计确定变量的位置。 同伴依赖性在任何可以估计的地方都存在,没有损失边目标会降低它,什么是移动是尾分是否来自其他标签的预测. 这把现象放在了体格和结构中.

blocks.en: The measurement relates to two existing lines of work. Like worst-group evaluation ( Sagawa et al., 2020 ) , it reports the performance an average conceals, but its groups are induced by label co-occurrence and computable from the label matrix, without annotated attributes or a trained model to cluster. Like SCUMBLE ( Charte et al., 2014 ) , it is computed from labels before training, but it is a proportion of each label’s positives tied to a bound on an evaluation measure, and it excludes definitional companions.

blocks.en: 6.2 Practical implications
blocks.zh: 6.2 实际影响

blocks.en:
The corpora on which we measure the effect are indexed under large annotation vocabularies. MeSH indexes biomedical abstracts, EUROVOC EU legislation, and others on a retail taxonomy and social tags. Automatic indexing with such vocabularies is in production. MEDLINE has been indexed algorithmically since 2022 ( MEDLINE 2022
Initiative, 2021 ; MTIX, 2024 ) ; national libraries deploy machine-assisted subject indexing ( Poley et al., 2025 ; Kasprzik, 2023 ) , and fine-grained semantic indexing below the level of a MeSH descriptor is an active line of work in this journal ( Nentidis et al., 2020 ) . These systems are evaluated by aggregate precision, recall and F1 ( MTIX, 2024 ; Krithara et al., 2023 ) , while rare descriptors remain the hard case ( Giustini et al., 2026 ; Poley et al., 2025 ) and audits of indexed records find omissions that affect retrieval ( Amar-Zifkin et al., 2025 ) . An independent occurrence is a document on which a rare descriptor carries information its frequent companions do not, and so a document reachable through that descriptor rather than through the labels it usually accompanies. A classifier that assigns the descriptor only alongside its companions adds little access for a searcher, while its aggregate score reports the index as serviceable. Independent recall measures the access a machine-assigned rare descriptor actually adds, in the sense of evaluating indexing in the context of retrieval ( Golub et al., 2016 ) , and it complements frequency-stratified evaluation ( Chalkidis et al., 2020a ) by stratifying on co-occurrence rather than on frequency.

我们用来测量效果的蝎子 是在大注释词汇下索引的 MeSH索引生物医学摘要,EUROVOC 欧盟立法,以及其他关于零售分类和社会标签的索引. 正在使用这些词汇自动编制索引。 MEDLINE从2022年开始按算法编制索引(MEDLINE 2022)

blocks.zh: 6.3 关于评价做法的建议

The estimand follows a principle of retrieval evaluation under incomplete judgments. Restrict the measure to where it is informative, and report it as undefined elsewhere ( Buckley and
Voorhees, 2004 ) . Three practices follow.

blocks.en: Benchmark maintainers can publish π ¯ \bar{\pi} , with S2–S4, beside a corpus’s label statistics. A corpus with a small bound is one on which this failure cannot materially inflate reported tail recall.

blocks.en: Method authors can report d d beside macro-F1 wherever it is estimable, with its co-report and the label space it was computed in. Importantly, the co-report is not optional. Distribution-balanced loss on Wiki10-31K lowers d d more than any other objective and without it would read as a correction (Section 5.3 ). The label space matters because companions are defined against its head set, so per-label effects from different label subsets are not comparable.

blocks.en: Reviewers can ask whether a tail result holds on more than one corpus, since no objective in our audit behaves the same way on two. Where a method raises companion dependence, as two objectives do on Ohsumed, the companion-rich corpora show no compensating gain in tail F1 (Section 5.3 ).

blocks.en: None of this requires our estimand. The screening statistic needs only a label matrix, Observation 1 holds for every measure computed from per-label confusion counts, and the evaluator reads prediction files from any producer.

blocks.en: 6.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.4 限制

blocks.en: The scope of the measurement is set by S1–S4, which concern the size and co-occurrence structure of the label space. How the labels were authored makes no difference. An uncontrolled social tag set carries one of the larger effects we measure, and the negative corpora lack scale rather than curation.
blocks.zh: 测量范围由S1-S4设定,涉及标签空间的大小和并发结构. 标签的写法没有区别。 一个不受控制的社会标签集 带有我们衡量的更大效果之一 负面的蝎子缺乏规模而不是治疗。

blocks.en: Restricted to independent occurrences, hard subsetting is undefined for almost every tail label on the test splits we examined, and reweighting does not recover the missing information. The natural reweighting equals hard subsetting, and the variants that differ reach a bias of − 0.19 -0.19 against synthetic ground truth where companion strength is at least 0.8 0.8 . The within-label estimand therefore answers only for labels estimable in both contexts and declines to answer for the rest. The screening bound is conservative, by an order of magnitude on our corpora, because the support ratio transfers only partly from training to test.
blocks.zh: 限于独立的出错,硬子设置对于我们所检查的测试分解上几乎每个尾部标签都没有定义,再加权不能恢复缺失的信息. 自然再加权等于硬分层,不同的变体对合成地真理的偏差达到−0.19-0.19,其中伴生强度至少为0.8.8.8. 因此,标签内部的印象和答案只针对在两种情况下都值得评价的标签,而对其他标签则拒绝回答。 筛选约束是保守的, 以数量级的顺序 对我们的蝎子, 因为支持比例 仅仅从培训 转移到测试。

Across α \alpha from 0.5 0.5 to 10 10 , at 5 seeds on EURLEX57K and Ohsumed, the largest rise in independent recall is 0.028, at 0.9 standard errors, because those positives are exactly what the phenomenon makes scarce. blocks.en: The extreme-classification family is not covered, because its published results use corpora for which we could not obtain usable text and no prediction files are released for it. The retrieval-augmented audit is one small model on one corpus, run to demonstrate the evaluator, not to characterize language models.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Macro-F1 over the tail cannot tell whether a rare label was recovered on its own or on the strength of its frequent companions, because it depends only on per-label confusion counts. We decompose per-label recall into companion-supported and independent components and propose a within-label estimand with a co-report rule, and a screening statistic computed from training labels that bounds the inflation of reported recall.
blocks.zh: 尾部上方的Macro-F1无法分辨出一个稀有的标签是靠自己还是靠频繁的伴生来恢复的,因为它只依赖于每个标签的混淆数. 我们把每个标签的召回分解成由同伴支持的独立部分,并提议一个标签内的意向和共同报告规则,以及从培训标签中计算出来的筛选统计,以限制所报告的召回的通货膨胀。

blocks.en: Screening 23 corpora and auditing the six on which the estimand is defined, we find companion dependence wherever it can be measured. No standard long-tail objective reduces it, and none behaves the same way on two corpora, so a tail result is evidence about the benchmark it was measured on. Where the effect moves, it moves with architecture. Tail scores derived from other labels’ predictions read as strongly dependent. The screening statistic bounds the inflation of reported recall on every corpus, conservatively, from training labels alone. For collections indexed under large annotation vocabularies, independent recall is the part of a rare descriptor’s performance that adds access for a searcher, and it is the part aggregate scores do not report.
blocks.zh: 筛选23 公司和审计 6 个被定义的意向, 我们发现伴侣依赖 任何地方它可以衡量。 没有标准的长尾目标能降低它,也没有一个在两个蝎子身上的行为方式相同,所以一个尾结果就是关于其被测量的基准的证据. 在效果移动的地方,它随结构而移动. 从其他标签的预测中得出的分数读取为高度依赖。 筛选统计仅从培训标签中就保守地将据报召回的通货膨胀限制在每一个实体上。 对于在大注释词汇下索引的集合,独立召回是一个罕见的描述器的性能部分,它增加了搜索器的访问权限,它是集合分数不报的部分.

blocks.en: Two lessons carry beyond this paper. The intuitive difference-of-F1 construction is dominated by a base-rate artifact and can reverse the sign of the effect, and a lower dependence reading is a correction only when independent recall rises. Future work is to create independent examples for the tail labels the screening statistic identifies, and to extend the audit to extreme classifiers once their predictions are available.
blocks.zh: 两个教训超越了本文的范围。 F1构造的直观相差以基率文物为主并可以倒置效果的标志,而下依附读取只有在独立召回上升时才是一种修正. 今后的工作是为筛选统计所查明的尾部标签创建独立的例子,并在获得极端分类者的预测后,将审计工作扩大到极端分类者。

blocks.en: Appendix E The base-rate null
blocks.zh: 附录 E 基准率无效

blocks.en: The null column of Table 4 asks how large the difference-of-F1 gap of Equation 10 would be for a model with no companion dependence, one whose output does not depend on companion presence given the truth. For each tail label we take the model’s own recall and false-positive rate, apply them in both contexts of the real partition, and recompute the gap. Expected true positives are split between S ⁡ ( l ) S(l) and I ⁡ ( l ) I(l) in proportion to | S ⁡ ( l ) | |S(l)| and | I ⁡ ( l ) | |I(l)| , and expected false positives between companion-carrying and companion-free negatives in proportion to their counts. Because each label keeps its own rates, the null permits labels to differ from each other and forbids only within-label context dependence, the more conservative of the two nulls we computed. The null share is the null gap as a percentage of the observed gap, averaged over five BCE seeds. A share above 100% means the base-rate artifact alone exceeds the observed gap. A negative share arises where the observed gap and the null gap have opposite signs: on Wiki10-31K, AAPD and arXiv-157 the observed gap is positive, conditioning appearing to raise tail F1, while the null predicts a negative gap, so the artifact there pushes against the reading rather than producing it.
